$comment: Objects of the Z-Anatomy .blend that are excluded from every export because they probably derive from components under a non-commercial licence. Z-Anatomy credits those components but does not tag objects, so this list is conservative and must be re-checked when the blend is updated. Read by scripts/build_mapping.py; src/manifest.ts fails if a quarantined mesh reaches a bundle. See docs/adr/0005-model-licensing-policy.md.

dundee-inner-ear.credit: Anatomy of the Inner Ear, University of Dundee School of Medicine
dundee-inner-ear.note: The Dundee model also contains the ossicles (its own description: tympanic membrane, facial nerve, ossicles and vestibular system), and derives from the McGill 3D ear (CC BY-NC-SA 2.5 Canada). BodyParts3D has no ossicles, so the ossicles of the blend are probably from this source.
